The needs-check rule says to change it only when the receiver is confirmed to be a Pydantic model, so I did not rewrite Snapshot.parse_obj(). If app/legacy.Snapshot is confirmed as a v1 BaseModel, parse_obj should become model_validate in a follow-up. Other v1 calls in this file were not in the findings and were not touched: record.dict() in export_record, get_record(raw).json() in record_json, and snap.copy() in restore.
